about: Recordings for the composer's call of the recorded-model double (T-1071, C-123). Each is one plan answer keyed by the sha256 of its canonical composer input (K-03 v1: $defs/composeInput in, $defs/plan out). They are seeded from K-03 v1's plan fixtures (contracts/message-plan/fixtures), not recorded live: no model call is made (J-02a). The s1-02 pair is K-03's own (input-s1-02, plan-s1-02). K-03 has no input for its other five plans, so each has a small synthetic input in ai/recordings/composer-inputs, written from the master's sample cast (Sam, Lee's Barbershop, Alex M., Riley, Ben T., the 5160 code, 88 Elm St) and fixture set v1's therapist demo shop (Lee Associates, Maya); no real person or customer appears (rule 9). Slot values in the inputs' facts are the slot examples of slots.json.
